title: Word List Moved

illustrates.quote: Regardless of print location, place the word list before the first question.

blocks.text: Write the word that completes each sentence.

items.text: 1. Something that you do well is called a \_.
2. Feeling good about yourself means you have \_.
3. The way your body reacts to something new or difficult is called \_.

print.notes: Print places the boxed word list AFTER the three questions (at the bottom of the page); 10.7.2e requires the word list to be moved before the first question in braille regardless of print location — this is exactly what this sample illustrates, so print.blocks deliberately keeps the word list in its OWN (unmoved) print position, matching the source book’s own worked-example convention: EVERY sample in this section models print.blocks in print’s own order, never braille’s reordering, so a reordering rule’s own effect shows up as a genuine mismatch when built.
